case_name: Add a logo or text overlay
title: Append a Clean End Card
tests: Tests appending an accurately timed end card with exact text while preserving the complete source clip and its audio.

judge.summary: The sampled output shows matching cockpit footage followed by a clean, centered black end card with both requested lines correct.

must_haves.item: The entire original cockpit clip plays before the end card, without being replaced or shortened.
must_haves.why: The sampled footage matches the supplied source frame and shows progression, but the complete original and output timelines are not available to verify every second.

must_haves.item: A solid black end card occupies only the final 2 seconds of the 9-second output.
must_haves.why: The output is 9 seconds long, with cockpit footage at 5.6 seconds and a solid black end card at 7.9 seconds; the exact transition time is not shown.

must_haves.item: The end card reads exactly 'Ready for takeoff?' with '@flightschool' on the line below.
must_haves.why: Both strings appear exactly as requested, in the correct order on separate lines.

must_haves.item: Both lines are white, centered, fully visible, and comfortably readable.
must_haves.why: The white text is large, centered, unclipped, and clearly legible against solid black.

must_haves.item: Original cockpit audio is preserved during the source footage, followed by silence during the end card.
must_haves.why: The transcript confirms cockpit dialogue is present, but does not establish complete audio preservation or silence specifically during the end card.
